link.reason: A theory that the causeway shafts were industrial infrastructure; the nearest story, which says the shafts connect to underground facilities, is a different claim about the same shafts.

candidates.title: Team statement that limestone absorbs the signal from the known Khafre chambers
candidates.quote: This is because the structures are embedded in a limestone slab that absorbs the signal.
documents: Facebook page statement

link.reason: A team statement explaining why the known Khafre chambers did not show up (limestone absorbs the signal); no story holds this statement, and the critique of the SAR model is a different account.

candidates.title: Promise of new SAR scans of Khafre to detect the Belzoni chamber
candidates.quote: I ensure you that more scans will be done on the Khafre in order to find something to detect Belzoni.

link.reason: A promise of future SAR scans to find the Belzoni chamber; no story covers this planned scanning.

candidates.title: Unexplained vertical bedrock shafts beside the Khafre causeway
candidates.quote: So, there's also no good archaeological explanation for what those shafts are for. From from the pharaonic burial perspective, archaeology and Egyptology does not have a good explanation for those vertical bedrock shafts adjacent to the causeway.

link.reason: Place-lore that Egyptology has no explanation for the causeway shafts; this differs from telling 3's industrial theory and from the underground-connection story.

candidates.title: Causeway shafts are waterproof and hold air, not water
candidates.quote: And I tell you that for me the shafts are waterproof. It means that the water that is the water level if you if you if you can see the water level that is outside the shafts, the water is not able to go inside the shafts.

link.reason: A theory that the shafts are waterproof and hold air; no story makes this claim.

candidates.title: Proposed project to clean the shafts with robots, with the University of Ferrara
candidates.quote: And so, the project proposal that we are as submitted we are thinking to submit these weeks. We are involving University of Ferrara,

link.reason: The same shaft-clearing proposal with the University of Ferrara that the Khafre Research Project story holds, and the same proposal as telling 2.
link.difference: Adds that robots would do the cleaning and that the proposal would be submitted within weeks.

candidates.title: Alvarez muon scan of Khafre found nothing above the Belzoni chamber
candidates.quote: So this next thing I mentioned that there was a muon scanning of the central pyramid. Luis Alvarez, I knew I recognized the name, so he was a part of this. They scanned the Belzoni chamber and the area above the Belzoni chamber. They didn't find anything.
documents: Alvarez muon scanning paper (1970s)

link.reason: The same muon scanning paper on the central pyramid that Jeffrey cites in the 1970s muon-scan story.
link.difference: Names Luis Alvarez and says the scan found nothing above the Belzoni chamber.

candidates.title: Modern muon detection of a big void by the Grand Gallery, and how muon scanning can fail
candidates.quote: So now the modern the modern muon detectors. They are it is highly probability that they are saying that there is a big void on the Grand Gallery which is parallel,

link.reason: Filippo's account of the modern muon finding of the Big Void beside the Grand Gallery and how muon scanning can go wrong; this matches the story that the muon team mistook the gallery's floor and roof for the void.
link.difference: Describes the void as parallel to the Grand Gallery and talks about muon failure in general, without naming the floor or roof.

candidates.title: Iron ore tube vein in a boat pit
candidates.quote: So here I'm down inside of one of these {quote} {unquote} boat pits. Mhm. And this is an image This is a tube.

link.reason: Jeffrey shows a particular iron ore tube he saw himself inside a boat pit. The metal ore veins story is about what the plateau's veins contain in general, not this tube in this pit.

candidates.title: SAR columns explained as hydrothermal vents above a magma chamber
candidates.quote: Here we have what Filippo's team is showing, which could be the remnants of some of these hydrothermal mineral vents,

link.reason: Jeffrey's theory that hydrothermal mineral vents rose through the old seabed under Giza, here used to explain the vertical columns in Filippo's SAR scans.
link.difference: Links the vents to the vertical columns in Filippo's team's SAR scans and puts a magma chamber beneath them.

candidates.title: Karst cave and tunnel system venting hydrogen sulfide under Giza
candidates.quote: And in this paper they've also shown that there is a karst cave and tunnel system Mhm. that is the source of hydrogen sulfide gas coming up from the Giza Plateau.
documents: unnamed paper on karst cave system at Giza

link.reason: An unnamed paper is cited as showing a karst cave and tunnel system that is the source of hydrogen sulfide gas at Giza. The cave and tunnel stories below come from Luke Caverns' account and from Biondi's SAR findings, and neither involves the gas or this paper.

candidates.title: Great Pyramid as a chemical plant fed by hydrogen sulfide
candidates.quote: And my hypothesis for the function of the Great Pyramid is that the hydrogen sulfide gas coming from this subterranean karst cave and tunnel system is the initial reactant in the chemical manufacturing sequence within the Great Pyramid.

link.reason: Jeffrey's own theory that the pyramids were chemical plants, told here for the Great Pyramid.
link.difference: Told firsthand by its author, who names hydrogen sulfide from the karst caves as the first reactant.

candidates.title: Giza iron ore samples contain gold, silver and rare earth elements
candidates.quote: So, the samples of the iron ore deposits on the Giza Plateau also contain gold, silver, electrum, precious metals, rare earth elements, everything that you could think of.

link.reason: The same claim that the Giza iron ore veins hold gold, silver and rare earth elements, by the same teller.
link.difference: Adds electrum and says nothing about platinum.

candidates.title: Fulgurites in Giza iron veins as evidence of high-voltage current
candidates.quote: In these iron ore veins, we have samples that contain fulgurites, which is evidence of high-voltage electric current distribution through these iron veins.

link.reason: The claim that fulgurites in the iron veins show high-voltage current ran through them is not in any story below. The metal ore story is only about what the veins contain.
